title: LLaMA-Factory Trainer (SFT, DPO, ORPO, KTO)
description: Headless LlamaFactory v0.9.5 fine-tuning on Runpod Serverless: send an official LlamaFactory YAML (or a few form fields) and an alpaca/sharegpt dataset, get a LoRA/QLoRA adapter. SFT, DPO, ORPO, SimPO and KTO; LoRA, QLoRA, freeze or full. Default: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 QLoRA on a 24 GB GPU. No Gradio, no baked weights.

config.gpuIds: ADA_24,AMPERE_24,ADA_48_PRO,AMPERE_48,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 1g.24gb,-NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition MIG 2g.48gb

input.name: Base model
input.description: Hugging Face model to fine-tune (owner/name). Default Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (Apache-2.0, not gated, bf16). Any model LlamaFactory supports works; its license is yours to accept. Override per job with input.model_name_or_path.

input.name: Model revision
input.description: Commit SHA / tag of the base model. Empty = the pinned default revision for Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, or 'main' for other models.

input.name: Chat template
input.description: LlamaFactory template name. Required for non-Qwen3 models (e.g. llama3, mistral, gemma3, qwen3_nothink).

input.name: Training stage
input.description: sft = supervised fine-tuning. dpo = preference tuning (DPO / ORPO / SimPO via PREF_LOSS). kto = KTO with kto_tag labels.

input.name: Preference loss (stage dpo)
input.description: sigmoid = DPO, orpo = ORPO, simpo = SimPO. Only used when STAGE=dpo.

input.name: Quantization
input.description: 4 = QLoRA 4-bit bitsandbytes (least VRAM, default). none = 16-bit LoRA (more VRAM).

input.name: Fine-tuning type
input.description: lora (default), freeze or full. freeze/full need quantization=none and much more VRAM.

input.name: Dataset
input.description: Default training data: a public Hugging Face dataset id, a bundled set (tiny_sft, tiny_dpo, tiny_kto) or a LlamaFactory data/dataset_info.json entry. Comma-separate several. Per job: input.dataset / dataset_url / dataset_inline.

input.name: Dataset URL
input.description: Default http(s) URL of a .json/.jsonl/.csv/.parquet file or a .zip/.tar.gz (optionally with its own dataset_info.json). Max 2 GiB.

input.name: Dataset format
input.description: auto = detect alpaca (instruction/input/output) or sharegpt (conversations/messages).

input.name: Epochs
input.description: Training epochs (ignored when Max steps > 0).

input.name: Max steps (0 = use epochs)
input.description: Hard cap on optimizer steps. Use 5-30 for a smoke test.

input.name: LoRA rank
input.description: LoRA rank (lora_target=all).

input.name: Cutoff length
input.description: Max tokens per example.

input.name: Max samples (0 = all)
input.description: Use at most this many examples per dataset.

input.name: Learning rate
input.description: Empty = stage default (1e-4 for SFT, 5e-6 for DPO/KTO).

input.name: Per-device batch size
input.description: per_device_train_batch_size.

input.name: Gradient accumulation
input.description: gradient_accumulation_steps.

input.name: Checkpoint every N steps
input.description: Checkpoints land on the network volume for resume.

input.name: Push adapter to HF repo
input.description: Optional owner/name. Needs HF_TOKEN with write access. Override per job with input.hf_repo_id.

input.name: Private HF repo
input.description: Create the HF repo as private.

input.name: Hugging Face token (use a Runpod secret)
input.description: Do NOT paste a raw token. Create a Runpod secret (e.g. hf_token) and enter {{ RUNPOD_SECRET_hf_token }}. Needed only for gated/private models, private datasets and pushing the adapter.

input.name: Training timeout (s)
input.description: Watchdog: kill training after this many seconds (0 = 6 h default). Also set the endpoint execution timeout.

input.name: Worker init timeout (s)
input.description: Large image (~9 GB); allow time for the first pull.
